# Agent Plugins schemas (test fixtures)

`1.0.0/plugin.schema.json` and `1.0.0/mcp.schema.json` are verbatim copies of the
Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas from
[agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec](https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec)
(`schemas/1.0.0`, commit `ff8ab5e`, 19 August 2026), used offline by
`tests/plugin.test.mjs` to validate `taxcal-plugin/`. They are licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`). Replace them when the package moves
to a newer Agent Plugins version.
